title: Consistent Hashing
subtitle: Add a server to a hash ring and see exactly which keys change owner.

lines: const ring = servers.sort((a, b) => a.hash - b.hash);

derivation: The visible code scans v server positions. A production ring can binary-search sorted virtual nodes in O(log v).

edgeCases.label: Wrap around
edgeCases.why: Positions beyond the final server wrap to the first.

edgeCases.label: Boundary positions
edgeCases.why: A key at the server position belongs to that server.
